description: This file contains the source code for the Voucher model class within the Opencart Admin module, responsible for managing voucher data including create, read, update, and delete operations.

classes.name: Voucher
classes.description: Model class for managing voucher data, including CRUD operations and history management.

methods.name: addVoucher
methods.description: Inserts a new voucher record into the database using provided data and returns the inserted record's ID.

methods.name: editVoucher
methods.description: Updates an existing voucher record identified by voucher ID with new data.

methods.name: deleteVoucher
methods.description: Removes a voucher record and its related histories from the database based on voucher ID.

methods.name: getVoucher
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a voucher by its ID.

methods.name: getVoucherByCode
methods.description: Fetches voucher details based on its unique code.

methods.name: getVouchers
methods.description: Returns a list of vouchers with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalVouchers
methods.description: Returns the total count of vouchers in the database.

methods.name: getTotalVouchersByVoucherThemeId
methods.description: Returns the total number of vouchers associated with a specific voucher theme ID.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Deletes all history records associated with a specific voucher.

methods.name: deleteHistoriesByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes voucher histories linked to a specific order ID.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Fetches histories for a voucher, supporting pagination.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Gets the total number of history entries for a voucher.
